newsitem.title: FRANCE: Templeton holds 3 pct of Cr Foncier - SBF.
newsitem.headline: Templeton holds 3 pct of Cr Foncier - SBF.

text.p: U.S. fund manager Templeton holds 3.004 percent of Credit Foncier de France, the troubled property lending group that is due to be taken over by French state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) as part of a wind-down, the French SBF stock markets association said on Tuesday.

Templeton had at one stage owned around 10 percent of Credit Foncier, which is due to be put under what Finance Minister Jean Arthuis recently called a "managed wind-down" after reporting losses of 10.8 billion francs for 1995.

Arthuis recently announced that CDC would offer shareholders 70 francs a share on behalf of the government as part of the Credit Foncier wind-down plan and the total cost of the transaction would be around 2.5 billion francs.
Templeton declared its latest holding after reducing it to below the five percent threshold, which requires notification under french bourse regulations, the SBF said in a statement on Tuesday.
The CDC takeover has yet to be carried out.
